title: 20 Years of European Credit on Tradeweb - the Making of a Credit Super Trader
summary: As we celebrate 20 years of European credit on Tradeweb, we’re building on two decades of collaborative innovation with our clients and dealers to extend the reach of trader expertise. Data that brings the market into sharper focus. A broad liquidity network. Flexible trading protocols. Automation that puts trader-defined logic to work.
body_markdown:
As we celebrate 20 years of[European credit](https://www.tradeweb.com/our-markets/institutional/credit/) on Tradeweb, we’re building on two decades of collaborative innovation with our clients and dealers to extend the reach of trader expertise.


Data that brings the market into sharper focus. A broad liquidity network. Flexible trading protocols.[Automation](https://www.tradeweb.com/our-markets/institutional/trade-cycle/automated-trading/) that puts trader-defined logic to work.


Together, we’re building for what’s next.
More connected. More intelligent. More capable.


Watch “The making of a credit super trader.”
